# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## What this repo is

Not a software project — it's the content/automation pipeline for an Instagram
recruitment account ("フリーランス美容師の働き方&求人", `@freelance_biyoshi_kyujin`)
for a hair salon (piece201, Nakameguro). There is no build/lint/test suite; the
"product" is Instagram carousel posts generated by Python scripts and published
via Metricool.

Full history/decisions/all captions: `docs/handover.md`. Step-by-step how-to for
the whole pipeline: `docs/guide.md`. Read `docs/guide.md` before doing pipeline
work if this is your first turn in this repo — it has the exact commands.

## Hard rules — do not skip these

1. **Never generate images before the user approves the slide structure + full
   caption text.** Always draft and present both first, wait for explicit OK,
   only then call `build_postN()`.
2. **Never call the Metricool `createScheduledPost` tool without an explicit
   instruction to publish/schedule** (e.g. "投稿して"). Drafting and generating
   images is not permission to post.
3. **Schedule at least 20 minutes ahead of the current time.** Shorter buffers
   cause `createScheduledPost` to fail with "Publication date cannot be in the
   past" after Drive-upload delays eat the buffer — the retry then triggers a
   second write-permission prompt for the user.
4. **Space posts at least 3 days apart, and vary the exact time and hashtag
   set each time — never post daily.** (Revised 2026-09-18: the original
   "1/day" cadence caused 13–15本目 to fail with Instagram's automated
   `"We restrict certain activity to protect our community"` error after 5
   straight days of identical-time, identical-format API posts — a classic
   bot-pattern flag. Check `getScheduledPosts` for the next open slot ≥3 days
   out, and deliberately avoid picking the same hour every time even when
   `getBestTimeToPostByNetwork` ranks it highest for multiple days in a row.)
5. **Until the account's posting is confirmed stable again, schedule new
   posts with `autoPublish: false`** so they land as a push notification for
   the user to tap-publish by hand in the Metricool app, rather than
   `createScheduledPost`/`updateScheduledPost` publishing unattended via the
   API. Revisit this once a few manually-tapped posts succeed without errors.
6. **Fact-check concrete numbers before writing them into a caption** (tax
   figures, percentages, deadlines, etc.) — use WebSearch, don't rely on
   memory or the client's recollection.
7. **Never commit `secrets/`** (OAuth client secret, refresh token). It's
   gitignored; don't work around that.
8. **After every meaningful change, update `docs/handover.md`** (captions,
   roadmap status, pipeline history with Metricool post IDs) and commit/push
   to `claude/automation-planning-verification-lcupt0`.

## Commands

Generate one post's images (from repo root):
```bash
python3 -c "
import scripts.generate_all_slides as g
g.build_postN(materials_dir='./assets/materials', out_dir='./assets/posts/postN')
"
```
`SRC`/`OUT` in `generate_all_slides.py` default to `./materials` / `./output`
(relative to cwd), which don't exist at repo root — always pass
`materials_dir='./assets/materials'` and `out_dir='./assets/posts/postN'`
explicitly, or the script fails with `FileNotFoundError`.

Upload generated slides to Drive (needed before Metricool can ingest them —
`createScheduledPost`'s `media` field requires public URLs, not local paths):
```bash
OAUTHLIB_INSECURE_TRANSPORT=1 python3 scripts/drive_upload.py assets/posts/postN/postN_final_slide1.jpg ...
```
Delete them from Drive once Metricool's response shows the URLs converted to
`static.metricool.com` (safe to delete only after that confirmation):
```bash
OAUTHLIB_INSECURE_TRANSPORT=1 python3 scripts/drive_upload.py delete <fileId> ...
```

Re-authenticate Drive OAuth when uploads fail with `invalid_grant: Token has
been expired or revoked`:
```bash
python3 scripts/oauth_step1_get_auth_url.py   # prints a URL for the user to open + approve
# user pastes back the resulting http://localhost/?state=...&code=... URL (it 404s, that's expected)
OAUTHLIB_INSECURE_TRANSPORT=1 python3 scripts/oauth_step2_exchange_code.py "<that URL>"
```

## Architecture

Pipeline: **draft/approve → generate images (Pillow) → upload to Drive for a
public URL → `createScheduledPost` via the Metricool MCP tool → delete Drive
temp files → update handover.md → commit/push.**

`scripts/generate_all_slides.py` is one file containing every post's image
recipe. Each post is a `build_postN()` function (N = 5, 7–16 so far) that
calls shared layout primitives:
- `draw_cover_slide()` — title slide
- `draw_title_body_slide()` — heading + body, the workhorse for numbered
  point slides (①②③...)
- `draw_comparison_row_slide()` — "A vs B" comparison table
- `draw_closing_slide()` — combined summary + DM-CTA slide (always the last
  slide; never split summary and CTA into two slides)
- `fit_font()` — auto-shrinks font size so text never overflows the 1080px
  canvas; all the `draw_*` functions already call it, so new text doesn't
  need special handling for long strings

To add a new post: copy the most recent `build_postN()`, adjust text, add it
to the `if __name__ == "__main__"` block at the bottom, generate, then eyeball
the rendered slides (Read tool) before uploading — especially cover slides
and any comparison tables, where overflow bugs have happened before.

`config/drive_config.json` holds the Metricool `brandId` (`6852890`),
timezone (`Asia/Tokyo`), and the Drive upload folder ID — read from there
rather than hardcoding if it might change.

## Content/domain knowledge worth knowing upfront

- Three distinct hairdresser employment terms used precisely throughout —
  don't conflate them: **面貸し/フリーランス** (booth rental, full commission
  60–70%, no salon-provided new clients, free schedule — this is piece201's
  actual arrangement), **業務委託** (commission ~40–50%, salon brings new
  clients, some time constraints), **雇用** (salaried + 10–20% commission,
  most constrained).
- Captions cap at 5 hashtags (Instagram display limit).
- Post body copy stays salon-neutral; piece201 gets mentioned only in the
  closing slide/caption CTA, never mid-post (this account is meant to grow
  into a multi-salon media property later).
- Emoji render as "✕" if drawn into the Pillow images (the CJK fonts have no
  emoji glyphs) — emoji only belong in caption text, never in
  `draw_*_slide()` calls.
